description: Turn one trend from find_trends_for_business into content for the user: a single post (their own image, never the creator's clip), a short video script they film on their phone via a teleprompter link, or an Instagram carousel. Same pipeline as creating from a shared link. Pass the tailored hook and idea from find_trends_for_business to keep the angle.

context.description: Anything the user added, e.g. a product to feature

format.description: post = one social post, script = phone-filmed video with teleprompter, carousel = Instagram slide deck, reel = (audio trends only) product photos cut to the trending sound, no camera

idea.description: The tailored content idea from find_trends_for_business

mediaUrls.description: reel only: 2-20 image URLs to cut to the sound, instead of productIds

platform.description: Post only: which platform to write for (default facebook)

productIds.description: reel only: product ids from list_products (e.g. ['feed-17']) whose photos are cut to the sound

scheduledFor.description: ISO date to schedule the post or carousel for

name: create_from_trend
title: Create From Trend
